title: Auth config parity + redaction: canonical Authorization header + safe debug logging
author: Mateusz Zielinski
release_notes: Go SDK: standardized API key discovery + header behavior to match cross-SDK auth spec; added redaction for secrets in debug logs and errors.
description:
Context: As part of the SDK parity audit, Go auth behavior diverged from Python/TS in a few ways: (1) environment variable discovery order differed, (2) some requests ended up with non-canonical header casing depending on call paths, and (3) debug logging could accidentally emit Authorization values in verbose mode. This PR aligns the Go SDK with the cross-SDK auth standard and Security guidance.

What changed: (a) API key discovery order is now consistent: explicit client option (WithAPIKey) > REDWOOD_API_KEY > REDWOOD_INFERENCE_API_KEY (legacy) and then error; (b) requests now set Authorization via http.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer <key>") to guarantee canonical header casing and avoid duplicate headers; (c) debug logging and error wrapping now redact secrets (Authorization, x-api-key variants) by default; (d) error messages for missing keys now include clear remediation steps without leaking sensitive values.

Compatibility notes: Server-side accepts Authorization: Bearer <key>; we keep accepting the legacy env var name for now. If callers explicitly set their own Authorization header via custom transport/middleware, the SDK will not overwrite it.

Testing: Added unit tests for env var precedence, header setting, and redaction in log output. Also added a small regression test ensuring we never include raw API keys in formatted errors.

Refs: ENG-2484 (auth standard), SUP-9355 (customer feedback on unclear auth errors). Security sign-off requested from Marcus/Kevin per sdk-auth-handling-secure-defaults guidance.
commits: go(client): standardize api key resolution + improve missing-key error text
go(auth): set Authorization via Header.Set and avoid duplicate header paths
go(logging): redact secrets from debug logs and wrapped errors
test(auth): env var precedence + header + redaction coverage
docs: update Go README snippet for REDWOOD_API_KEY and Authorization behavior

Mateusz Zielinski (author): Added a conservative URL sanitizer in the debug logger that removes common secret param names (api_key, token) when printing request URLs.

Elliot Price (docs): README currently mentions REDWOOD_API_TOKEN in one spot; should be REDWOOD_API_KEY.

Mateusz Zielinski (author): Fixed README snippet and aligned wording with the cross-SDK auth standard.
